method: Actual native Xfce Terminal window screenshots captured with cua_repl.getScreenshot(). The terminal displayed read-only excerpts of the saved real execution log; these are not screenshots of the original execution in progress.
caption_ru: Просмотр сохранённого журнала реального запуска в облачном терминале.
display_notes: The shell prompt was shortened to backup_practice$ for legibility. Terminal font was increased through its View menu. No pixels were drawn, synthesized, or edited. No destructive test was rerun for capture.
